description: One transport-neutral example for agent hosts. It defines data dependencies, not an executor or authority to perform effects.

transport.mcp: tools/call model-fidelity.OPERATION with the same model-fidelity.request.v1 JSON; opt-in PAD_MACHINE_COMMANDS=model-fidelity
transport.result: model-fidelity.result.v1 on both transports; do not infer success from a missing response

availability.rule: Do not issue unavailable operations. Record not-run with a reason until their drafts merge; continue other scoped delivery.

steps.action: Build through the host's existing authorized workflow. Capture a new attempt and bundle for changed bytes; do not replace original plan or earlier evidence.
Bind an actual review artifact to the built bundle; host establishes provenance. Missing review is not an approval wait.
Observe the built behavior in the authorized host runtime; if not run, return null callerStep and reason, never invented proof.
Stop only the offending action. Name the confirmed finding and stopped action; do not stop unrelated delivery.

steps.when: wrong change and scoped rollback permitted
steps.action: Check current revision and manifest digest against clearance before effect; deprecate key assets first. Record observed, failed, unknown or not-permitted outcome without silently replaying.
Use a NEW requestId. The rest of the evaluate payload binds the new bundle and original plan; stale target is a finding, not permission to roll back.
Use an actual returned artifactId or resultId, never both or a guessed ID. If evaluate was unavailable, read an actual prepare or diagram result instead.
Report evidence and gaps. The result grants no merge, publication or rollback authority.

branches.complete: Keep findings separate from the operation status and continue.
branches.partial: Keep missing checks, review, diagrams and runtime explicit; continue.
branches.tool-error: Record the typed error or unsupported operation; continue other scoped work.
branches.interrupted: Record no JSON and uncertain effects; inspect stored evidence before a new attempt. Never blindly replay.
branches.stop-red-line: Only the confirmed offending action stops; read and report the rest.
